description: This file contains utility functions for unit testing, including time retrieval and element presence checking in RBUS, with includes for gtest and RBUS headers.

methods.name: getCompileTime
methods.description: Populates a struct tm with the current compile time based on __DATE__ and __TIME__ macros.

methods.name: isElementPresent
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a specific element in RBUS, retrying until found.
